Defeat your third opponent in your quest to learn polymock.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Defeat [[Blarp]] in a game of [[Polymock]] at [[Gadd's Encampment]].
* See Hoff [Polymock Master] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 200 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* [[Ice Imp Polymock piece]]

==Walkthrough==
Blarp's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
#[[Earth Elemental Polymock piece|Earth Elemental]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Stone Daggers}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Obsidian Flame}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Earthquake}}
#[[Ice Elemental Polymock piece|Ice Elemental]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Ice Spear}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Frozen Armor}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Glyph Freeze}}
#[[Fire Elemental Polymock piece|Fire Elemental]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Flare}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Fireball}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Rodgort's Invocation}}

The following pieces are good counters:
*[[Kappa Polymock piece]] vs. [[Earth Elemental Polymock piece]]
*[[Fire Imp Polymock piece]] vs. [[Ice Elemental Polymock piece]]
*[[Skale Polymock piece]] vs. [[Fire Elemental Polymock piece]]

An alternate piece lineup is:
*[[Skale Polymock piece]] vs. [[Earth Elemental Polymock piece]]
*[[Gargoyle Polymock piece]] vs. [[Ice Elemental Polymock piece]]
*[[Kappa Polymock piece]] vs. [[Fire Elemental Polymock piece]]

Blarp can be quite difficult to defeat as he uses three Uncommon pieces (and you're likely to only have one, the Kappa). Be sure to Block/Drain the two most important skills of each piece. The latter is more powerful.

These are the skills to watch out for:

*Earth Elemental: Earthquake (650 damage, 6 {{energy}}, 1 {{activation}}, 20 {{recharge}}), Obsidian flame (800 damage, 6 {{energy}}, 1 {{activation}}, 20 {{recharge}})
*Ice Elemental: Frozen Armor (+1000 Health for 30 seconds, 2 {{energy}}, 2 {{activation}}, 20 {{recharge}}), Glyph Freeze (600 damage, 6 {{energy}}, 1 {{activation}}, 20 {{recharge}}
*Fire Elemental: Fireball (800 damage, 6{{energy}}, 1{{activation}}, 20{{recharge}}), Rodgort's Invocation (200 damage, 10 degeneration for 15 seconds, 2{{energy}}, 2{{activation}}, 20{{recharge}})

Keep in mind that by strafing (walking from side to side) you can avoid getting hit by projectiles such as Polymock Stone Daggers, Ice Spear, Flare and Fireball.
